meta.title: YOUNGER
meta.description: Personalized wellness data with an AI coach that helps you read your lab report.

hero.title: Understand your data before you supplement.
hero.description: Upload an existing report, or we help you get tested. Browsing is open; membership is required when we hand you to an advisor or need to keep your records.

paths.title: Do you already have a blood test report?
paths.withReportHint: Upload a photo. Choose a one-time reading or premium product selection.
paths.withoutReportHint: Choose assisted testing or premium selection, then pay before collection.

plans.title: Three plans
plans.name: Plan
plans.midWho: No report; you need a blood test

login.title: Log in so we can match your records
login.description: This is mock login. PHP auth comes later. You only need it to pass to an advisor, pay, or save a report.
login.guestHint: Not ready? Go back and browse plans.

member.title: My health
member.welcome: You're signed in. Report summaries, orders, and bookings will live here.
member.chatHint: The first AI coach only explains numbers and lifestyle tips. It will not prescribe products.

handoff.title: Pass to advisor
handoff.body: This step requires an account. Without membership we cannot match reports or bookings. The advisor consult stays on the Y system; this app only sees status.

chat.placeholder: Ask what a lab number means…
chat.empty: Try a question, e.g. what a low vitamin D result means.

footer: YOUNGER client app · PHP after UI flows are confirmed
